correctness.rationale: For the printed Kong–Shao delayed fear/Crowley–Martin predator-stage system, positivity and global boundedness follow from the quasipositive vector field, logistic upper control of P1 and bounded maturation forcing. With q=d2+c2, K=(r-d1)/c1, a=c2/q and R=eta*b2*c2*K/[q*d3*(1+b1*K)]<1, choose eps>0 with a*eta*b2*h(K+eps)<d3, h(x)=x/(1+b1*x). The actual Lyapunov–Krasovskii functional L=a*P2+P3+c2*int_{t-tau2}^t P2(s)ds has exact derivative Ldot=a*eta*b2*P1*P3/[(1+b1*P1)(1+k*b3*P3)]-d3*P3-c3*P3^2; the current and delayed juvenile terms cancel. For sufficiently large t, Ldot<=-delta*P3-c3*P3^2. Since L>=0 and decreasing eventually, P3 is integrable; bounded P2 and delayed P2 make dot P3 bounded, hence P3->0 by uniform continuity/Barbalat. Variation of constants then gives P2->0; P3(t-tau1)->0 and logistic upper/lower comparison give P1->K. This holds for all fixed nonnegative delays and positive histories, not at R=1. A compact invariant set entirely within the strict positive cone cannot carry an orbit converging to the boundary. Independently reproduced exact symbolic denominator factorization, cancellation, local-condition equivalence, the equality of candidate and earlier R, and the example 93/928 versus 1/12. The earlier published proof also establishes the same general theorem, so scientific correctness is unaffected by failure of originality.
